description.value: Venturi-Schulze Vineyards is a family farmstead winery established in 1987 on Vancouver Island, practising natural viticulture — no pesticides, herbicides, or irrigation — on a south-facing estate that also produces artisan balsamic vinegar, verjus, and jams. The property includes an outdoor patio tasting area that welcomes leashed dogs, and products can be purchased directly from the wine shop or ordered online with gate pickup available. The winery has earned recognition for its eco-friendly approach and estate-grown, minimally-intervened wines.

address.value: 4235 Vineyard Road, Cobble Hill, BC V8H 0A6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an operational family winery and tasting room in Cobble Hill, with an online store selling wines, balsamic vinegar, and jams. The OSM phone number and V8H 0A6 address are confirmed by the website's contact page, though the website footer inconsistently shows a different postal code (V0R 1L5). No mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere on the site, but the FAQ explicitly states wines are produced without any animal products, directly confirming vegan and vegetarian suitability.
concerns: Name discrepancy: OSM uses 'Venturi Schulze Vineyards' (no hyphen); the website consistently uses 'Venturi-Schulze Vineyards' (with hyphen).
Postal code discrepancy within the website itself: the contact page shows V8H 0A6 (matching OSM) while the footer shows V0R 1L5; the correct postal code should be verified.
Website copyright is dated 2019; the site may not be actively maintained, though content appears current.
Two distinct contact emails appear on the website: happy@venturischulze.com (matching OSM) and marilyn@venturischulze.com.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An operational family winery with a tasting room and direct-purchase wine shop on a popular Vancouver Island cycling corridor; the dog-friendly patio and artisan product range make it a natural stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ states: 'We do not use any animal products in our processing, including, but not limited to, egg white, gelatin, isinglass (derived from fish) or blood. Our wines meet the requirements for vegan or vegetarian diets.'
